issue.title: test_waiter_reclaims_stale_live_holder times out while labeling the holder stale-heartbeat
issue.description:
## CI failure

- **Node:** `tests/test_suite_gate_reclaim.py::test_waiter_reclaims_stale_live_holder`

The waiter is supposed to reclaim a live holder whose heartbeat is stale (`stale_timeout=0.05` after a 0.12s wait). Instead it times out after 5s reporting the holder as `stale-heartbeat` but still occupying both tokens. Failed in the scoped `just check` lane and again in an isolated `just test` rerun of the same node on this tree; no pass observed. Not the closed flake `sase-qp` (that was `test_fresh_heartbeat_is_not_reclaimed` under starvation, retired 2026-08-24).

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Failed in just check and again on an isolated just test rerun of the same node on this tree; no pass observed. The waiter reports the child holder as stale-heartbeat but never reclaims its two tokens within 5s. Distinct from closed flake sase-qp (test_fresh_heartbeat_is_not_reclaimed).
